name: Heat Shimmer
body:
School illusion (glamer); Level alchemist 1, bard 1, magus 1, sorcerer/wizard 1

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V

EFFECT

Range touch
Target creature touched
Duration 1 round/level (up to 5 rounds) (D)
Saving Throw Will negates (harmless); Spell Resistance yes (harmless)

DESCRIPTION

This spell functions as blur, except the effect only lasts for 1 round per caster level (maximum of 5 rounds).
